## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: positive sector breadth coupled with large-cap dispersion (MSFT, PLTR, AMZN ABOVE TREND vs AAPL, JNJ, LLY BELOW TREND) and narrow leadership concentration (Top 5 skewed to Technology). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +31.68% | 1M: +22.73%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +21.49% | 1M: +1.73%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: ETN (1W: +15.15% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +1.12%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: XOM (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +12.84%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +13.27%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare lagging: LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: MO (1W: -9.02% | 1M: -5.30%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -6.62% | 1M: +1.16%) CORRECTION. Utilities weak overall (sector negative).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +31.68% | 1M: +22.73%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +21.49% | 1M: +1.73%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +17.85% | 1M: -9.27%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); Style: Growth/Momentum.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LIN (1W: -5.19% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -5.36% | 1M: +2.63%) CORRECTION, PLD (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -0.82%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -6.62% | 1M: +1.16%) CORRECTION, ABBV (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select defensives and real estate.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +31.68%), MSFT (1W: +25.29%), ORCL (1W: +21.49%), AMZN (1W: +20.17%), LRCX (1W: +17.85%). Major divergence: multiple large caps (LRCX, INTC, AMAT, AMD, TSLA) show RECOVERY patterns (1W positive | 1M negative) — tactical caution; watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is leading 1W (+8.91%) but internally mixed: MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.58% | 1M: +8.38%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND. Sector strength but with dispersion and narrow leadership; overall sector contribution key to market tone.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials steady: JPM (1W: +0.06% | 1M: +5.86%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +3.45%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +7.31%) ABOVE TREND — sector supportive of risk tone.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure 1W (-2.39%): LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -1.70%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: +0.63% | 1M: +9.00%) ABOVE TREND — mixed, defensive names not uniformly leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor high-conviction tech winners and select cyclicals while monitoring narrow leadership and major divergence signals; favor MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to lagging defensives showing confirmed weakness such as LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND; monitor RECOVERY names for follow-through.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +31.68% | 1M: +22.73%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -9.03% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -8.60% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +8.91%) and Industrials (1W: +2.45%) — watch leadership breadth within Tech. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -2.39%) and Utilities (1W: -2.67%) — defensive lag may persist.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch MSFT to sustain 1W momentum for broadening leadership; AAPL reclaiming short-term trend would ease market dispersion; NVDA holding recent gains would confirm Tech’s depth; AMZN keeping 1M strength supports risk tone — failure of these triggers would increase market caution.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MAR (+75): Marriott headline ups outlook but price BELOW TREND (1W: -9.99% | 1M: -9.10%) — sentiment diverging from price, monitor for distribution. (Other high-score names exist in news feed; cross-check price before action.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-60): Pfizer headline on Covid pill revenue plunge while price is ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.63% | 1M: +9.00%) — bearish sentiment diverging from price. ABBV (-50): AbbVie headline and price confirming weakness (1W: -7.37% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND. TSLA (-45): headline pressures and RECOVERY pattern (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -22.02%) — tactical risk if 1M trend fails to roll over.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum style. MSFT (1W: +25.29% | 1M: +27.43%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +31.68% | 1M: +22.73%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +20.17% | 1M: +13.62%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: narrow tech leadership and major RECOVERY divergences (LRCX, INTC, AMAT, AMD, TSLA) warrant monitoring and confirmatory follow-through before enlarging exposure.
